obligations.statement: The dispenser must be mounted to a wall such that it remains in place during operation and refilling.
derivation_premises: A product that is not secured to the wall will fall or move when used.

obligations.statement: The dispenser must contain a volume that holds approximately twenty items.
derivation_premises: Physical volume is required to store items.

obligations.statement: The dispenser must release exactly one item per lever press when items are present.
derivation_premises: A mechanism that can release more than one item per actuation cannot satisfy the requirement.

obligations.statement: The dispenser must be refillable from the top while mounted without disassembly.
derivation_premises: An opening must be accessible from the top while the dispenser is attached to the wall.

obligations.statement: The dispenser must not jam or fail to release when nearly empty.
derivation_premises: A mechanism that relies on gravity or orientation may not function when the number of items is low.

obligations.statement: The lever must be reachable and operable by the user when the dispenser is mounted at typical height.
derivation_premises: A lever that cannot be reached cannot be operated.

obligations.statement: The top opening must be accessible for refilling while the dispenser is mounted.
derivation_premises: Refilling requires an opening that is positioned and oriented for access.

obligations.statement: The mechanism must be configured such that one actuation of the lever results in exactly one item being dispensed.
derivation_premises: A mechanism with multiple release points per stroke would violate the requirement.

obligations.statement: The dispenser must support the weight of its contents when mounted.
derivation_premises: A container holding items experiences gravitational load.

obligations.statement: The lever actuation must not require excessive force from the user.
derivation_premises: If the lever requires too much force, the user cannot operate it as intended.

unresolved.decision: How to achieve exact one-release without risk of double release or jamming under low fill.
unresolved.why_open: Requires detailed mechanism design and analysis of motion and clearances.

assumptions.statement: The capacity requirement is interpreted as number of items, not volume or weight.
assumptions.why: Capacity is stated in 'items' and the assumption clarifies the unit.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If customer specifies volume or weight.

assumptions.statement: The wall mounting is at a typical height, allowing the user to reach the lever and top opening.
assumptions.why: The scenarios assume user access to the lever and top opening.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If mounting height is restricted or user reach is limited.

assumptions.statement: The items are of a single uniform type and size.
assumptions.why: Capacity in items and one-at-a-time release are easier to interpret.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If multiple item sizes are to be dispensed.
